candidate_name: Côte d'Ivoire LNG import terminal (possible CI-GNL / Abidjan FSRU revival)
sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Côte d'Ivoire / CI-Energies (Ministry of Mines, Petroleum & Energy); original CI-GNL consortium led by TotalEnergies (Total exited May 2021)
current_state: Original CI-GNL/Vridi FSRU shelved since ~2021 (no construction; Total exited May 2021; CI-Energies re-tendered an Abidjan FSRU June 2021). U.S. trade.gov (2025-12-15) reports Côte d'Ivoire is still PLANNING an LNG import terminal in early stages, completion targeted ~2030, cost still under evaluation — not explicitly linked to the CI-GNL project.
missing_threshold_elements: No named operator/sponsor for the post-2021 effort, no confirmed location/capacity for the new plan, no FID, no cost estimate, no firm timeline. Cannot tell yet whether the 2025 'planned' terminal is the CI-GNL FSRU re-emerging or a new project.
watch_for: A CI-Energies/government award of the re-tendered Abidjan FSRU; a named operator or FSRU vessel; an FID or cost figure for the ~2030 LNG-import terminal; any statement explicitly continuing or formally cancelling the CI-GNL/Vridi project.
